items.title: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US restrictions
items.summary: DeepSeek has reportedly raised $15 billion in one of China's largest funding rounds, just days after the US ordered federal agencies to remove its technology over national security concerns.

items.title: Blackstone’s Jas Khaira says fears over AI-buildout debt are overblown
items.summary: Blackstone’s AI head on why the PE giant isn't panicked by market jitters.

items.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026: Everything you need to know
items.summary: TechCrunch Founder Summit is a full-day gathering in Boston on November 4 where founders across all stages connect with top VCs and experienced entrepreneurs to gain tactical insights on building and scaling their companies.

items.title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
items.summary: Meta Muse users are adopting the app for shopping and personal productivity, the company said during its Q3 earnings call. The AI app now has over 10M users.

items.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
items.summary: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.

items.title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
items.summary: As Amazon blocks AI agents from shopping on its site, Walmart is taking the opposite approach, introducing new technology that lets AI agents make purchases on customers' behalf, with controls over spending and transaction approvals.

items.title: PHP Armageddon: OpenAI, Google’s Wiz find ancient holes, panicking the internet
items.summary: This is the kind of security issue that was found and prevented by AI, but is also a high risk because of AI.

items.title: Blacksmith hits unicorn valuation after Sequoia leads Series C
items.summary: Blacksmith, a platform that lets companies build and test AI code more effectively, just announced a $66 million Series C round led by Sequoia that values the company at $1 billion.

items.title: AI promises productivity, but for managers, it’s mostly a headache for now
items.summary: More than 50% of managers say they're finding it harder to evaluate employees' work after adopting AI, according to a new survey.

items.title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
items.summary: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI running amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.

items.title: Hugging Face CEO warns that Netflix’s OpenAI hack documentary isn’t accurate
items.summary: Before you share the Netflix documentary "AI Gone Rogue," take note. Clem Delangue, Hugging Face's co-founder who is featured in the film, says it went "full doomer mode" and isn't accurate.

items.title: Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
items.summary: Anthropic is reportedly struggling to secure enough compute from cloud providers that increasingly view it as a competitor, even as its infrastructure spending balloons ahead of a planned November IPO.

items.title: SpaceX’s AI business is beating expectations
items.summary: SpaceX hit profitability in the third quarter, with net income of $4.4 billion. AI was the engine.

items.title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
items.summary: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.

items.title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers
items.summary: Google has joined Amazon in releasing a developer tool that makes it easy for PyTorch users to move their apps off Nvidia GPUs.

items.title: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
items.summary: The company says the feature is designed for situations where users might be discussing something personal or planning a surprise and want to keep those conversations private when handing their device to friends or family to show them something in another chat.

items.title: Eric Schmidt reportedly owns about half as much of Anthropic as CEO Dario Amodei
items.summary: Eric Schmidt’s fortune is about to get even bigger.

items.title: Meta’s Muse hits 10M US downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
items.summary: New data also shows Muse is retaining users at higher rates than its AI rivals.

items.title: Ex-Nvidia-turned-VC Amulya Vishwanath: ‘Physical AI is in its LEGO era’
items.summary: It’s the moment everyone is waiting for — the ChatGPT moment for robotics, Amulya Vishwanath explained to TechCrunch’s Equity.

items.title: Plants can speak using electricity, so this startup built an AI model to decipher their language
items.summary: Electric Plant has built an AI-powered translator to help humans listen to what plants are saying with the subtle electricity coursing through their stems.
